name: taskly
description: Taskly — convenience scripts to run the Laravel API and React frontend

scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "& { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000,5173 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { taskkill /PID $_ /T /F 2>$null }; $deadline = (Get-Date).AddSeconds(15); do { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $left = netstat -ano | Select-String ':8000|:5173' | Select-String -NotMatch 'TIME_WAIT' } while ($left -and (Get-Date) -lt $deadline); if ($left) { Write-Host 'WARNING: ports still busy - wait a few seconds or reboot.' } else { Write-Host 'Ports 8000 and 5173 are fully released.' } }"
